summary: Pritzker endorsed Senate resolutions to block U.S. arms sales to Israel in August 2025, calling it 'the right kind of message' to pressure Netanyahu, and publicly rejected AIPAC's Illinois spending as 'interference' in March 2026. He had earlier downplayed Chicago's 2024 Gaza ceasefire resolution for not holding Hamas accountable, and in May 2026 stated that criticism of Israel is crossing into antisemitism. His recorded positions center humanitarian concern and Netanyahu-specific pressure while drawing a line on criticism of Israel.
